pages.zh_cn:
# 铁砧与火
利刃不会自己变强。
- [item:minecraft:anvil] 可合并附魔、修复装备
- [item:minecraft:enchanted_book] 的附魔可经铁砧转移
- 命名你的武器，让它的传说开始流传
pages.en_us:
# Anvil and Fire
A blade does not grow strong by itself.
- The [item:minecraft:anvil] merges enchantments and repairs gear
- Enchantments from [item:minecraft:enchanted_book] transfer via anvil
- Name your weapon; let its legend begin

pages.zh_cn:
# 附魔之秘
附魔台倾听你的祈祷。
- 书架环绕 [item:minecraft:enchanting_table] 可提升等级
- 钻石工具附魔后远胜于量
- [effect:minecraft:strength] 让重剑更沉重
> 力量不是祝福，而是代价。
pages.en_us:
# Secrets of Enchanting
The enchanting table listens to prayers.
- Surround [item:minecraft:enchanting_table] with bookshelves for higher levels
- Enchanted diamond tools outmatch mere numbers
- [effect:minecraft:strength] makes heavy blades heavier
> Power is not a blessing; it is a price.
